landing.hero.subtitle: Give ClusterForge a topic and your website. Get 5 subtopics, 50 user-intent questions, AI answers, and a publish-ready pillar page + 5 cluster pages.
landing.features.title: Everything you need for a topic cluster
landing.features.subtitle: From a single keyword to a complete, publish-ready content plan.
landing.features.f1.title: 5 subtopics per keyword
landing.features.f1.desc: Pick a topic and we return 5 semantically related subtopics with their own long-tail keyword.
landing.features.f2.title: 10 user-intent questions
landing.features.f2.desc: For each subtopic, 10 real questions your audience is actually searching for.
landing.features.f3.title: AI-written answers
landing.features.f3.desc: Every question gets a concise, on-brand answer — ready to paste into a CMS.
landing.features.f4.title: Pillar + 5 cluster pages
landing.features.f4.desc: One pillar page linking to 5 cluster pages. SEO topic-cluster strategy, automated.
landing.features.f5.title: Markdown export
landing.features.f5.desc: Download every page as clean markdown. Works with any CMS or static site.
landing.features.f6.title: Live progress
landing.features.f6.desc: Watch each generation step update in real time — no guessing what the worker is doing.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.subtitle: Four steps. One click. A complete content cluster.
landing.how.s1.title: Enter topic & site
landing.how.s1.desc: Your pillar keyword and a URL or short audience description.
landing.how.s2.title: AI research
landing.how.s2.desc: Gemini expands into 5 subtopics and 50 questions in the background.
landing.how.s3.title: Content generation
landing.how.s3.desc: Answers, then cluster pages, then the pillar page — all in markdown.
landing.how.s4.title: Review & publish
landing.how.s4.desc: Preview rendered pages, download markdown, and ship to your CMS.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.a1: One pillar page for your main topic plus 5 cluster pages, each with 10 Q&As. Every page is in markdown.
landing.faq.q2: Do I need my own API key?
landing.faq.a2: Yes — set GEMINI_API_KEY in your .env. The Google AI Studio free tier is enough to try the full flow.
landing.faq.a3: Typically 1–3 minutes depending on the chosen Gemini model and current demand.
landing.faq.q4: Can I edit the generated content?
landing.faq.a4: Yes — copy the markdown or download it, then edit in your CMS. In-app editing is on the roadmap.
